data.title: BlackRock's IBIT ETF Flashes Golden Cross As SEC Approves Triple-Leveraged Bitcoin, Ethereum ETPs
data.description: The SEC approved a Cboe rule change on Friday that allows six triple-leveraged products to list, including funds tied to Bitcoin and Ethereum.
